properties.name: Across designs
properties.purpose:
The parts that reason about MORE THAN ONE design at once: composing two without merging them, declaring and checking a dependency on another design's version, and saying when two linked designs disagree at a boundary.

The smallest group at three, and deliberately not folded into a larger one. Everything else in this system assumes a single design and can read whatever it needs; these three cannot, and each has to handle a design it does not own and cannot write. That is a different set of assumptions, and burying it inside a bigger box would hide the one boundary in the system where the other side is out of reach.
